description: This Java class defines a REST controller for managing notification queues, including endpoints for enqueuing notifications and listing recent queued items. It uses Spring Boot annotations for REST mappings, security, and API documentation.

classes.name: NotificationQueueController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints to enqueue notifications and retrieve recent notifications, secured with role-based access control.

methods.name: NotificationQueueController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the controller with a NotificationQueueService instance.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Handles POST requests to enqueue a new notification into the queue, with security requiring NOTIFICATION_WRITE authority or ADMIN role.

methods.name: recent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list recent notifications, with security requiring NOTIFICATION_READ authority or ADMIN role.
